overview.headline: How DNA stores hereditary information and copies itself

keyPoints.point: DNA is the hereditary material in humans and other organisms.
keyPoints.quote: DNA, or deoxyribonucleic acid, is the hereditary material in humans and almost all other organisms.

keyPoints.point: Most DNA is located in the cell nucleus with a small amount found in mitochondria.
keyPoints.quote: Most DNA is located in the cell nucleus (where it is called nuclear DNA)

keyPoints.point: The information in DNA is stored as a code made of four chemical bases.
keyPoints.quote: The information in DNA is stored as a code made up of four chemical bases: adenine (A), guanine (G), cytosine (C), and thymine (T).

keyPoints.point: DNA bases pair with specific partners to form units called base pairs.
keyPoints.quote: DNA bases pair up with each other, A with T and C with G, to form units called base pairs.

keyPoints.point: DNA can replicate and make copies of itself so new cells have an exact copy.
keyPoints.quote: An important property of DNA is that it can replicate, or make copies of itself.

keyTerms.gloss: DNA located in the cell nucleus that carries most hereditary information
keyTerms.quote: Most DNA is located in the cell nucleus (where it is called nuclear DNA)

keyTerms.gloss: small amount of DNA found in mitochondria that converts energy from food
keyTerms.quote: but a small amount of DNA can also be found in the mitochondria (where it is called mitochondrial DNA or mtDNA)

keyTerms.gloss: unit made of a base, sugar and phosphate that forms the DNA strand
keyTerms.quote: Together, a base, sugar, and phosphate are called a nucleotide.

keyTerms.gloss: spiral structure formed by two long strands of nucleotides with base pairs
keyTerms.quote: Nucleotides are arranged in two long strands that form a spiral called a double helix.

keyTerms.gloss: units formed when adenine pairs with thymine and guanine pairs with cytosine
keyTerms.quote: DNA bases pair up with each other, A with T and C with G, to form units called base pairs.
